Implement priority support in this TypeScript planner library. Preserve existing public behavior except the specified ordering extension.
Requirements: Task has priority low | normal | high. createTask accepts optional priority; omission defaults to normal. updateTask accepts priority. Invalid priority values (including null, empty strings, numbers and unknown strings) throw DomainError with code INVALID_PRIORITY without mutating the original task. Explicit undefined is omission and must not erase existing priority.
toTaskJson emits priority; fromTaskJson reads it, defaults legacy JSON with no priority to normal, and rejects invalid values. MemoryStore retains priority and its copy/workspace isolation behavior.
listForDay preserves workspace/owner/day/not-done filters, then sorts high before normal before low, then ascending position and ascending id. Legacy Task-like objects missing priority sort as normal. Do not mutate input arrays or objects. plannerView exposes priority consistently.
Use existing architecture and exports; keep dependency-free TypeScript. Modify only src/ (and optional lekalo/ metadata if present). Do not modify tests or package/config files. Do not commit, deploy, access external services, use subagents, or inspect outside this workspace. Run node --test test/public.test.mjs before final submission. Finish with a brief summary.
